messages:
Maya (Marketing): quick sync: we need a compact battlecard + webinar hook focused on 'serving-first' advantages vs cloud APIs and DIY infra. keep it rep-friendly.
Sam (Sales): got it. reps want 1-line opener + 30s discovery script + two objection retorts (cost, lock-in).
Alex (Product): emphasize deterministic latency, reserved capacity, and automated fallbacks. not just raw perf numbers.
Priya (Research): bench snippet we'll call out: chat p95=120ms (2k seq), embed median=45ms; cost normalized per 1k tokens. will attach a plain table.
Owen (Field): procurement checklist: SLA, private deploy path, KMS/HSM integration, audit log retention. I'll draft a 1-paragraph FAQ.
Maya (Marketing): webinar format idea: 20-min exec lightning + 40-min deep lab (live runbook demo + Q&A). test vs single 45-min.
Sam (Sales): subject lines to test:
A) "How to make LLM inference predictable (and cheaper)"
B) "Serving-first playbook: cut token spend without downgrading quality"
C) "Prod-ready LLMs: rollouts, fallbacks, and reserved capacity"
Maya (Marketing): good. Sam can run A/B on SDR list.
Sam (Sales): will run A/B, track CTR and SQL conversion.
Alex (Product): include two rep scripts: discovery (30s) and procurement opener (30s).
Maya (Marketing): draft scripts: 
- Discovery: "Are you seeing token cost surprises or latency spikes in production? Redwood helps keep inference steady and unit economics predictable."
- Procurement: "We offer reserved capacity, KMS integrations, and an SLA tailored for inference workloads."
Priya (Research): adding quality guard note: "prompt-linked evals + regression alerts; we monitor for quality drops when applying quantization or batching."
Owen (Field): case study candidate in pilot; I'll confirm NDA and produce an anonymized 3-line blurb.
launch-bot: Webinar provisional: 2024-07-25 11:00 booked. :calendar:
Maya (Marketing): deliverables + owners: one-pager (Maya), rep scripts & knockouts (Sam), procurement FAQ & case blurb (Owen), bench methods & table (Priya), product sign-off (Alex). lock by next Wed. :rocket:
Sam (Sales): noted, will post drafts by EOD tomorrow.
Priya (Research): sending short methods blurb + raw numbers in-thread in ~90m.
Maya (Marketing): thanks team — I'll assemble final battlecard and the 6-slide TL;DR once pieces land. link draft folder: https://drive.redwood.example/marketing/playbook-drafts :pushpin:
